notes: Identity verified from the supplied text: title Getting a Job: Is There a Motherhood Penalty?; Shelley J. Correll, Stephen Benard, and In Paik; copyright 2007; AJS Volume 112 Number 5 (March 2007): 1297–1338. The full article text includes laboratory methods, results, tables, audit study, conclusions and references. Its printed ending page is 1338, whereas the neutral reference says 1339. DOI is not printed in the supplied text, so DOI identity is not independently established; title/authors/journal/year identify the referenced primary report. No PDF path supplied. The p.26 locator identifies Table 4. Printed coefficient retained on its binary-logistic scale, without exponentiation or standardization. N is explicitly printed for the critical model, not inferred from df or summed. Target is the motherhood interaction: the text on p.1320 describes mothers relative to other applicants and Table 4 identifies Parent#female applicant. This is not the main effect of Parent (.570), nor a separately estimated mothers-versus-childless-women contrast. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Canonical significance legends use the extraction glyph ! for less-than.
